note: Testnet limits, read by script/DeployCreditStack.s.sol. The settlement token is the ZENOMARKETS testnet USDG (6 decimals, public mint), so these caps carry no real money. Mainnet limits live in robinhood_mainnet.limits.json.

credit.note: supplyCap is in TSLA base units (18 decimals): 1e24 = 1,000,000 TSLA. borrowCap is in USDG base units (6 decimals): 1e12 = 1,000,000 USDG. Staleness is 24 hours because the keeper moves the testnet price at any hour.
